observation.name: Distance
observation.rules: Entry: route=(phase%2) XOR pulse; badge=registry_bit XOR challenge. Incorrect pair is fatal. After entry, a bridge needs (wall_tick+phase)%4 in its phases and, if powered, indicator==initial_polarity. A powered crossing costs 1 battery. Read/survey/inspect/relay take 1 tick; moves take travel ticks. Flood at tick 64. Reach relay and exit.
